release_contents:
Phase 4 backend (commit 08efe65, the admin-erp half of the admin-controlled homepage carousel — the matching institutional/ frontend commit dcccebe ships separately, through that site's own git-archive + Hostinger Node build pipeline, not this one).

New table homepage_carousel_slides (image_path, bilingual title/alt_text/link_label pairs, link_url, sort_order, status active|inactive). New Admin\HomepageCarouselController mirroring ObjectiveController's own shape exactly (index/create/store/edit/update/destroy + moveUp/moveDown + toggleStatus, no drag-and-drop UI) with an image upload layered on top via PhotoUploadService::storePrivate()+promoteToPublic() in the same request (no separate moderation step for this feature, unlike a Notice's cover image). Reuses the existing 'settings' permission module rather than adding a new one, per Permission::MODULES's own 'don't invent a module per page' docblock. New public contract: GET /api/v1/public/homepage-carousel (no pagination — a carousel is always a small bounded list), image_url built via the same direct-disk-URL pattern already used for approved member/committee photos. First non-Phase-3 consumer of <x-admin.bilingual-field>, the tabbed editor built in the previous deploy. Upload failures route through upload_error_label() so an English-locale admin never sees a raw Bangla exception message.

15 new admin tests (CRUD, image upload/replace/delete with real Storage::fake() assertions, link_url/link_label paired validation in both directions, reordering, status toggle, RBAC, bilingual editor round-trip) + 5 new public-API tests (active-only filtering, sort order, full response shape, null link fields, empty-carousel response). Full local suite: 545 passed, 2259 assertions, before this deploy's own build re-ran it (also green, via mariadb_test_suite:true in the build's own checks_passed).

post_deploy_production_e2e: Backend-only verification so far (no slides exist in production yet, and none were created this pass — unlike Phase 3's E2E, there is no safe hidden/draft state to exploit here since a freshly-created carousel slide has no 'never shown publicly' guarantee the way an inactive Objective does; the public API only filters by status, and creating-then-deleting a real slide would mean at least one webserver-cache/CDN-adjacent window where a test image is technically fetchable). The public endpoint itself is confirmed live and correctly shaped (empty-array response, matching PublicHomepageCarouselApiTest's own 'empty carousel returns []' case). Full end-to-end verification (create a real slide through the admin UI, confirm it actually appears on the live public homepage in the right position with the right image/text, confirm the institutional site's own build/deploy has picked up the matching frontend commit) is PENDING until immediately after the institutional/ side of this same release is deployed — see that deploy's own record for the completion of this E2E pass.

cron_timing_note: Cron runs in UTC. One-shot crons scheduled 5-8 minutes ahead on specific minutes, read once via the cron-jobs output operation, then deleted immediately — none left armed (verified empty via a cron-jobs list call after smoke-test-live). One migrate-apply create-cron call in this deploy failed client-side with a transient DNS error (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND developers.hostinger.com) before reaching Hostinger at all; a cron-jobs list call confirmed no job had actually been created, so the retry was safe and did not double-schedule anything — worth that same list-to-confirm check any time a cron-create call itself errors, rather than assuming it's safe (or unsafe) to retry blind.
release_manager_path_reminder: release-manager.php lives at the PRIVATE path /home/u951246149/domains/provatferi.org/laravel-admin-releases/_tooling/release-manager.php for every step after the one-time install — NOT under public_html/admin/. The upload step's own generateUploadURLV1 call must target the domain admin.provatferi.org (the subdomain itself), not the parent provatferi.org — the parent domain's upload URL roots at that domain's own public_html (wrong tree entirely for this subdomain's docroot), while the subdomain's own upload URL roots directly at its docroot, matching upload-release.mjs's un-prefixed `_release_staging/...` destination path exactly.
never_fetch_a_staged_script_url: Requesting a staged one-shot script's URL EXECUTES it (it is under the web-servable docroot). Verify removal with the file listing tool instead.
local_mariadb_note: Confirmed running (mysqld.exe) before this deploy's local build-release.sh run.
curl_csrf_testing_note: When scripting a POST to a CSRF-protected route (e.g. /locale) with curl, fetch the CSRF token and set the cookie jar in the SAME request that will be reused for the POST, not across separate GET calls with the jar re-opened each time — doing it in two disjoint GET calls produced a spurious 419 in an earlier session even though the actual endpoint was working correctly.
monorepo_note: admin-erp/ and institutional/ are two subdirectories of ONE git repository (same origin remote, same commit history) — a commit that only touches one of the two still shares a SHA history with the other. build-release.sh already handles this correctly (it has throughout this engagement): it archives and ships only the admin-erp/ subtree for this pipeline. The institutional/ subtree of the exact same commit ships separately through that site's own deploy mechanism (git archive + Hostinger Node build + CDN purge) — the two deploys are independent operations against the same commit, not one combined step.
